# beaconcha.in

Beaconchain is a platform providing real-time data and analytics for the Ethereum 2.0 Beacon Chain, offering insights into validators, blocks, and network performance.

Category: Data. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/beaconchain/.

## Actions

- **Get Node Health**: Get the health status of the node.
- **Get Validator**: Retrieve information for a specific validator from beaconcha.in api.
